summary: Volatility in Adani Group shares following Hindenburg Research report; regulatory scrutiny under SEBI; Expert Committee constituted to assess regulatory framework; judicial review of SEBI's investigation; no basis for transferring investigation to SIT/CBI; conflict of interest allegations against Expert Committee dismissed; recommendations on volatility, short selling, and investor awareness upheld; SEBI directed to continue regulatory action.
legal_provisions_cited: Rule 19A of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules, 1957
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
final_judgment: Petitions dismissed; Expert Committee report accepted; SEBI investigation to continue without court-monitored SIT; recommendations for regulatory strengthening upheld.
